identify.prompt:
Analyze this person and provide a JSON response with:
1. name: Full name if you recognize them with 100% certainty (or null if unsure)
2. profession: Their profession/role if known (or null)
3. gender: Gender presentation (male/female/non-binary/unknown)
4. facial_features: Detailed description of face, hair, eyes, facial structure
5. clothing: Object with description, colors array, style, accessories array
6. pose: Body position and posture
7. expression: Facial expression and mood
8. held_items: Array of objects [{item: string, description: string}]
9. confidence: Your confidence in identification (0-100)

Example format:
{
  "name": "John Doe",
  "profession": "Actor",
  "gender": "male",
  "facial_features": "...",
  "clothing": {"description": "Black jacket", "colors": ["black"], "style": "casual", "accessories": ["watch"]},
  "pose": "Standing",
  "expression": "Smiling",
  "held_items": [{"item": "phone", "description": "smartphone"}],
  "confidence": 95
}

Format as valid JSON only.
identify.description: Identifies celebrities, actors, public figures by name

describe.prompt:
Describe this person and provide a JSON response with:
1. name: null
2. profession: null
3. gender: Gender presentation (male/female/non-binary/unknown)

5. clothing: Object with description, colors array, style, accessories array
